name: Andaz Pattaya Jomtien Beach
positioning: Oceanfront tropical resort on Na Jomtien with locally inspired rooms, beachfront suites, pool villas and multi-room houses
best_for: Couples wanting a beachfront suite or pool villa with direct beach access
Families and groups wanting a multi-room house or a kids' club

facts.text: The resort is a tropical retreat on the oceanfront.
It is a coastal resort a short drive from many of Pattaya's scenic attractions and tourism hotspots.
Rooms are locally inspired, with options including beachfront suites and pool villas.
Houses with multiple rooms are offered for larger families and groups.
Garden View rooms are timber-floored, with a daybed on the balcony.
Roof Garden rooms have a 4-meter-high sloped ceiling.
Rooms include a complimentary minibar with snacks and drinks.
The Heritage House is two storeys, and its rooms have ocean views.
Ruen Thai is a teahouse crafted from teakwood, with indoor and outdoor seating on two levels.
Fish Club is a beachside restaurant and bar that grills seafood caught by local fishermen over coconut husks.
Picnics can be set up in the gardens at Raintree Court or Tonsai Court, or on the beachfront.

highlights.text: The Beachfront Pool Villa has an ocean view, direct beach access and a private pool.
The Beachfront Suite has ocean views, direct beach access and a living and dining area.
Pool Access rooms have direct access to the lagoon pool.
Guests can paint a miniature Khon mask of Rama, Hanuman or Tosakanth.
The resort has the Sanuk Sanuk Kids' Club.

considerations.text: The address is in Na Jomtien, Sattahip; Pattaya's attractions and hotspots are a short drive away rather than on the doorstep.
U-Tapao International Airport is 24.9 kilometers away, while Suvarnabhumi Airport is 134 kilometers away.
Pets are not permitted at the resort.
